data.name: Fedor
data.strategy_desc:
On Forex, there is a stable pattern - the return of the price to the average value, after a strong movement. Therefore, a rollback strategy is used - after a strong movement of the currency pair, transactions open against the movement, in anticipation of a rollback.
Trade is completely automatic, which excludes the influence on trade psychological factor. During the release of important news (Brexit, US elections), trade is disabled.
Each pair has several sets, to diversify the inputs and outputs, this allows you to get a more even profitability graph.
The trading system has a high mathematical expectation, so any trading terms of the broker (spreads, swaps, slips...) are suitable.
If the volatility is higher or lower than certain limits, then trade is automatically turned off.
Almost all months close with a positive result. If a large loss is recorded, the recovery usually does not exceed 1-2 months.
